memory_note: Phase 3 step 3 (A800 40GB, runs/server-bench/colocate-probe): trainer and vLLM colocate. Worst-case training sequence (8192 tokens, 1024 completion) peaks at 6.03 GiB allocated / 6.33 reserved next to vLLM at 0.45 (KV cache 120,080 tokens), card peak 25.3 GB. 16 GiB is about 2.5x that peak; 0.45 x 39.5 GiB + 16 GiB stays under the card. 10.0 was the local 11 GB card.
lr_note: Audit revision 2C-3: constant 1e-5, no warmup. 1e-6 is a full-parameter GRPO rate; LoRA needs about 10x that (SFT-v1 used 1e-4). AdamW barely sees the constant T_norm scale, so 1e-6 would not move in 30 steps.

kl.note: Audit revision 3-1 item 4: the logged KL uses 64 sequences drawn at random with a seed fixed by (seed, step), not the first 64 (those are a few tasks). beta = 0, so this only changes the log.

eval.note: Audit revision 3-1 item 5: K=8 (was 4) for checkpoint selection, step 0 included. Held-out stays K=4.

stop.mixed_group_note: Audit revision 3-1 item 3: low entropy stops the run only if the mean fraction of groups with both successes and failures over the last 10 steps is also below 0.25.
